title: Verify: History effect ignores settles after cancellation unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the cancel guard
description: Test that late resolve/reject after close or round change write nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Late reject after close shows no error
Late resolve after roundId change adds no entries
technical_constraints: Deferred promises controlled in test; listMine mocked

steps.action: Create the file with the client mock. Test 'late reject after close is ignored': first listMine returns a deferred promise, render open then rerender open=false, reject the deferred, then rerender open=true with a second listMine resolving [], expect no 'Could not load your suggestions' alert. Test 'late resolve after roundId change is ignored': deferred for round 'r1' rerendered with roundId 'r2' resolving [], then resolve r1 with a contribution, expect its prompt not in the list. Test 'unmount does not warn': spy on console.error, unmount, settle, expect not called.
